queries.sql:
SELECT
        v.version_id,
        v.version_name,
        v.version_type,
        SUM(p.amount) AS amount
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_VERSION v
      JOIN SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        ON p.version_id = v.version_id
      WHERE p.account_code = 'rev-gross'
        AND p.period = '2026-09'
        
        
        
        
      GROUP BY v.version_id, v.version_name, v.version_type
      ORDER BY v.version_id
